h1: Custom 3/4 Sleeve Workwear for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom 3/4 sleeve workwear for your team. Perfect for branding with logos. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: 3/4 sleeve workwear offers a balanced look between short sleeves and long sleeves, making it a versatile choice for industries where employees need coverage without overheating. The extended sleeve provides more space for logo placement on the forearm, ideal for polo shirts like the Cornerstone® Select Snag-Proof Polo. This style works well for customer-facing roles in hospitality or retail, offering a professional appearance with added comfort.
heroAltText: Custom 3/4 sleeve workwear polo shirts with embroidered logo on forearm, ideal for team uniforms
